$comment: Hand-authored inputs for scripts/artifact.ts: a usage note per token, the type styles, and each pattern's preview card. Marks are uploaded assets in the artifact, so previews reference their blob URLs.

usage.neutral-950: Page canvas (via bg). Near-black; the ground everything sits on.
usage.neutral-925: Input, code block, modal and toast fill: one step above the canvas.
usage.neutral-900: Raised surface (via bg-raised), inline code chips.
usage.neutral-850: Reserved step between 900 and 800 for dense panel stacks.
usage.neutral-600: Faint text (via fg-faint) and corner ticks (via tick).
usage.neutral-500: Hover hairline (via border-hover) and link underlines.
usage.neutral-450: Subtle text (via fg-subtle): labels, meta, axis labels.
usage.neutral-400: Muted text (via fg-muted): body prose and descriptions.
usage.neutral-100: Strong text (via fg-strong) and the primary button's white fill.
usage.bg: Page background. Every text token below is checked against it.
usage.bg-raised: Raised surface: ghost-button hover, segmented active, inline code.
usage.bg-card: Panel and card fill: translucent neutral-925 over bg.
usage.bg-hover: Card, row and table-row hover wash.
usage.fg: Default text: headings, values, first table column. On bg, bg-raised and bg-card.
usage.fg-strong: Strongest text: code chips, emphasis. On bg and bg-raised.
usage.fg-muted: Body prose, descriptions, table cells. On bg and bg-raised.
usage.fg-subtle: Micro-labels, meta, axis labels; at least 4.5:1 on bg and bg-raised (source: 4.5:1 on bg-raised, 5:1 on bg). Nothing that must be read sits below this.
usage.fg-faint: Hints, placeholders, separators only. About 2.5:1 on bg: below the 4.5:1 text floor by design; never for text that must be read.
usage.border: Resting 1px hairline: panels, tables, frames, inputs.
usage.border-soft: Softer hairline: panel and card edges, table body rows.
usage.border-hover: Hover hairline and focus border (focus brightens the border, no rings). Also the :focus-visible outline.
usage.border-strong: Button and kbd outline; input hover.
usage.accent: THE accent, phosphor lime. Link hover, selection, caret, live dots, active markers, chart series 1, at most one accent button per screen. Never body text, washes or resting borders.
usage.accent-ink: Text on an accent fill (the accent button label, selection).
usage.accent-soft: Rare tint: a selected table row.
usage.link-hover: Prose link hover: text and underline turn accent.
usage.slime-lime: Artwork neon; graduated to accent in product.
usage.slime-cyan: Artwork and chart series 2. Not a UI color.
usage.ok: Status dot: ok. Always beside a lowercase word; diff add tint.
usage.warn: Status dot: warn. Always beside a lowercase word.
usage.error: Status dot: error; invalid input border and error help text on bg. Diff del tint.
usage.sp-0-5: Micro only: 2px optical half-step inside a row.
usage.sp-1: Icon to label, list desc offset.
usage.sp-2: Gap inside buttons, fields, tags; label to control.
usage.sp-3: Field padding, gaps between related items.
usage.sp-4: Rows breathe 16; button padding; shell gutter on mobile.
usage.sp-5: Panels breathe 20 inside (u-panel, u-card, panel-grid cells).
usage.sp-10: Header bottom margin; prose h1 top.
usage.sp-12: Frame padding; hero bottom; site header to title.
usage.radius-none: Default: panels, cards, tables, modals are square.
usage.leading-base: Body: mono needs air between lines.
usage.container-base: Data-dense shell (u-shell-base): tables, dashboards, the banded homepage.
usage.container-wide: Rare shell (u-shell-wide); cap inner prose at narrow.
usage.shadow-none: UI shadows: none. Elevation is a border plus background step.

styles.name: type-display-ceiling
styles.sample: we bet you've seen us before.
styles.usage: Marketing display only: the ceiling (text-3xl). Never pass it.

styles.name: type-stat-value
styles.usage: Stat values (u-stat-value): the same step as page titles.

styles.name: type-minor
styles.usage: List titles and minor headings h3 (u-h3, u-list-title, text-md).

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: lint and eval harness for agent skills.
styles.usage: Default body (u-p, text-base). Line-height 1.6: mono needs the air.

styles.name: type-secondary
styles.sample: removes the app from all 12 repos.
styles.usage: Secondary body, descriptions, buttons, fields, code (text-sm).

styles.name: type-micro-label
styles.usage: The hierarchy device (u-label): uppercase, tracked, fg-subtle. Kicks off sections, heads tables, labels fields.

styles.name: type-tag
styles.usage: Tags and tick labels (text-2xs): the floor, tracked caps only.

styles.name: type-code
styles.usage: Code blocks (u-pre) and the install line. Never wrap; scroll.
